rule: lesson = {trigger, cause, repair, evidence, scope}; persisted only when verified and reusable; reviewer decides

lessons.trigger: qualification/intrinsic.py (V2.1c design numerics) written without loading the biophysical-modeling skill
lessons.cause: no startup step routes modelling work to domain skills; skill loading depended on the agent noticing
lessons.repair: jomission-gate-runner step 1 names the domain skills to load
lessons.scientific_consequence: none implied by this fact alone (reviewer 2026-09-16); V2.1c numerics stand on their own tests

lessons.trigger: tier-0 failed after a legitimate TODO status change (SCI-V21C-BOUNDARY OPEN_AFTER_HARNESS -> OPEN)
lessons.repair: asserts durable invariants only (items exist in a live status; LOCKED gates stay LOCKED); validate_current_state checks statuses against evidence
lessons.scope: project tests: never encode current state in a test
lessons.recurrence: 2026-09-16 V2.1c-boundary seal: test_verdict_status_follows_evidence_not_tests read the live V2.1c review_override; repaired to build overrides on copies of the sealed V2.1b entry. Remaining tier-0 tests read only sealed evidence or copies.

lessons.trigger: owner retired the V2 chain 2026-09-19; tier-0 failed on test_preserved_science_todo asserting V2.2-RECURRENCE and BLIND-OMISSION LOCKED
lessons.cause: the test still encoded a current status despite its own durable-invariants comment; the L2 repair did not cover the chain assertion
lessons.repair: chain assertion accepts the durable set {LOCKED, RETIRED}; a retired chain becomes executable only by new authorization
lessons.scope: project tests: name the full terminal set, not the current value

lessons.trigger: WinError 32 on TemporaryDirectory cleanup in the t4_t5 and t7 artifact tests
lessons.cause: the test's own np.load keeps the npz zip handle open on win32; no mmap exists in the analysis modules
lessons.repair: close the NpzFile before the temp context exits; test-harness only, no quarantine
lessons.evidence: commit 9aa6283; serial reruns 31.39 s and 26.70 s, no PermissionError
lessons.scope: windows test hygiene: every npz load in a temp dir

lessons.trigger: five Q8 tests failed: DynamicState.__new__() missing theta_S, aux, b after the 0.4.24 migration
lessons.cause: state_replacement.py built the state from a hardcoded six-field list that predates the engine NamedTuple
lessons.repair: rebuild through the namedtuple's _replace (undeclared fields preserved by construction); derive field lists from DynamicState._fields
lessons.scope: any code that builds engine state: replace, never reconstruct

lessons.trigger: tier-2 foreground run aborted twice by the owner; detached relaunch killed by the harness (ChildProcess.kill on the spawning shell)
lessons.cause: this environment has no background execution: long foreground runs get aborted and detached processes are reaped
lessons.repair: run long batteries in the foreground with the owner present, or split them; do not relaunch detached
lessons.evidence: 2026-09-19: two owner aborts, one harness kill, zero output

lessons.trigger: editing jomission/*.py: whole-file normalization on top of the intended change, four times (t4_t5_analysis.py, builder.py, hdp_attractor.py, q8_phenotype.py, run.py in 39e8c18)
lessons.cause: edit-time formatter normalization (single-to-double quote flips, black-style rewrap, blank-line insertion): semantically null by construction; fires on the first edit per file, later edits stay small
lessons.repair: treat the first .py diff per file as suspect: git diff -w must show only the intended hunks; covering tests arbitrate

lessons.trigger: engine upgrade (jaxfne 0.4.24 to 0.4.25) with sealed results computed under the old engine
lessons.cause: the pin alone cannot tell a safe upgrade from a semantics change; promotion without evidence silently re-baselines sealed receipts
lessons.repair: read-only delta on touched surfaces; install; tier 0+1+2; seal migration evidence; promote authority and pin together; no tier-3 replay without an authorizing lineage
lessons.evidence: commits acd4289, 3640fd7, 12bb6e1; tier-2 395 passed, 3 skipped, 516 s under 0.4.25

lessons.trigger: rerunning failed or timed-out test files from a full-suite baseline
lessons.cause: 13 of 14 queued files were tier 3 (owner-gated); a bisect worker and a rerun ran tier-3 files unauthorised
lessons.repair: classify each file against manifests/test_tiers.json before any rerun; tier 3 only inside an authorising TODO
lessons.evidence: OPEN-28 (2026-11-05); sealed-write guard blocked all writes

lessons.trigger: check and commit chained in one shell line
lessons.cause: a ';' after pytest let a failing harness test reach a commit (stale spec path after a rename)
lessons.repair: chain checks to commits with '&&' only; after a rename, grep manifests for the old path
lessons.evidence: 99da930, fix 6114c6b; fresh clone at 7249e96 failed tier 0
